items.title: Håkan Rydin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Glasgow, Scotland, July 27, 2016
items.q: It was Herbie Hancock... Those were my four most important.

ctx.x: And you used a Fender Rhodes?

Yes, in the 70s I did and in the 80s yes. In fact I liked it, I still like the sound of it but it has terrible mechanics. It’s not so nice to play on. But I do like the sound. But if I was Herbie Hancock and someone or other brought it for me — but it’s I mean, bringing this heavy to a gig and you are like that, and then afterwards you have to take it home. So I got tired of it. So after I think like 25 years I sold it and I got more money selling it than I bought it in the early 70s.
